why: Naser came in with one question, what do you actually offer, because he already pays a local guy $200 a month for a website, his Google listing and his ads. He heard $297 and "systems to help you get more business organically on Google" inside the first two minutes, and he never heard why a smart website exists versus the one he has, or the three numbers he would see every month that Easy Local does not give him. So at minute 26 he said the two offers are "basically identical," and what he got back was an argument about AI browsing and tires instead of two questions he would have answered himself: does your site text the lead back, and how many leads did it produce last month. The only money math ran on a $25 missed call he never said he misses, after every price was already on the table. He left to "study it" with $297 against $200 as the comparison, when the comparison should have been his leads, his missed calls and his reviews tracked every month versus nothing tracked at all.
